item.title: Houthis advance in Yemen as government forces move to defend Aden

item.title: Iran war live: Third US carrier arrives, Iran warns it could strike first

item.title: Yemen’s Houthis unilaterally release 600 war detainees

item.title: Three men sentenced to death in Jordan over fatal church mass shooting
